statements.t: The Company expects to report full third quarter fiscal 2026 results on December 8, 2026.

Based on these preliminary results and current expectations for the remainder of the fiscal year, the Company maintains its fiscal 2026 net sales outlook of $7.8 billion to $7.9 billion and now expects fiscal 2026 Adjusted EBITDA (Non-GAAP) of $950 million to $960 million.
statements.when: the remainder of the fiscal year
